title: RoomCatalogData

room.description: The room's id: the surface id its assistant surface is published under (`room:<id>`).

description.description: What the room is for, in one or two sentences.

problems.description: The kinds of problem it reports, in its own vocabulary. Default: the generic `problems` schema.

recipes.description: Tasks its tools carry out together, which only the room knows.

RoomEntryInfo.description: What every catalog entry says about itself. Knowledge is generated from these words alone.

id.description: Stable, kebab-case, unique among the room's entries of its kind.

title.description: What the UI calls it: a button's label, a field's label, a command's name.

description.description: What it does, in a sentence or two, in the room's own terms.

control.description: Where a person does it: the tool, panel, button, key or gesture.

RoomActionData.description: One operation of the room, without its `run`.

input.description: An object schema: a tool's input is one, never a union at its top level. Its property descriptions are the parameters' documentation.

effect.description: What it changes: the document (`edit`), the selection, the view, files, backend data, a job, a transaction.

destructive.description: It removes or replaces something the person made; running it needs the person's approval (ADR-0228).

RoomSection.description: Which inspector section a field is in, as the inspector titles it.

RoomFieldAnimation.description: A field's animation, in a room with a timeline. Animation is a capability, not a requirement (ADR-0226 §2.6).

keyframeable.description: Set at the playhead, it is a keyframe there when the property is animated.

RoomFieldData.description: One inspector field, without its `read` and `write`: what it shows for the selection, and what setting it does.

appliesTo.description: The kinds of thing it applies to, in the room's vocabulary (`text`, `shape`, `artboard`…).

value.description: The value's schema: its type, range (`minimum`/`maximum`), options (`enum`) and unit (`x-unit`).

animation.description: How it animates, in a room with a timeline. A room without one leaves it out.

keyframeable.description: Deprecated since oui-bindings 0.8: `animation: { keyframeable }`. Read for one minor.

RoomCommand.description: One keymap command: what its key does.

group.description: The group the room lists it under: tools, objects, edit, view.

keys.description: Its keys as a person reads them (`⇧⌘G`). Empty when it has none.

status.description: `reserved`: its key is kept for a feature that is not built; it does nothing. Never offered.

options.description: Options the command takes beyond the selection (a nudge's direction).

RoomObservation.description: Something the room reports about its state: the document, what is selected, or the problems it has drawing it. The host pushes the value; the catalog declares what it means.

RoomProblemKind.description: One kind of problem a room or page reports, in its own vocabulary (`missing-font`, `order-rejected`): the kind, and what it means.

RoomProblem.description: A problem a room or page has drawing or reading what the person is working on: a face it cannot load, text it therefore does not draw, an asset that failed, something an import could not reproduce. Reported in a `problems` observation, so an assistant sees what the person sees in the banners.

message.description: The room's own words for it, as its banner says it.

hides.description: Ids of the things not drawn because of it.

resolve.description: How the person resolves it in the room: an action of this catalog, and the choices it offers.

detail.description: Anything else that names the problem precisely (the face, the element).

RoomChangedRow.description: One row an action changed: which list it is in, what addresses it, and everything about it now.

list.description: The list it is a row of: `<observation id>/<list property>`, or `<observation id>` when the observation itself is the list.

detail.description: Everything about the row now, as `inspect` returns it. Left out when the row was removed, and when an edit changed more rows than a result reports in full: `inspect` reads those.

removed.description: The edit removed the row: nothing addresses it any more.

RoomResult.description: What running a catalog entry or a bound control did: its data, or why it could not be done, in words a person would read. `pending` says the work outlives the call: a job was started and is done only when its completion arrives (an action whose effect is `job` or `transaction`). Every binding's `run` returns what the consumer's callback returned (ADR-0226 §2.2 rule 3, #209), so a handler's `{ ok, pending: { jobId } }` reaches the runtime.

changed.description: The rows it changed, added or removed, each as its list's reader reports it now (ADR-0244 §2.5): what the assistant checks its edit against, and the rows the page state keeps whole.

AgentCatalogManifestEntry.description:
Where a room package names its catalog, under `oui.agentCatalog` in its `package.json` (`closure.agentCatalog` is read during the transition). `hosts` are the exported components that mount the room (and register it); a page that renders one has the room's surface.

```json
"oui": { "agentCatalog": { "path": "./dist/agent-catalog.json", "hosts": ["VectorStudioRoom"] } }
```
